title: LOGOS ASF — DEP.KEYSTONE / GovSec V2 Training Ingress Record
description: Constitutional data contract for DEP.KEYSTONE / GovSec V2 / Layer Zero training-source admissibility records. No training data may enter TR-04A, TR-03, TR-04B, or TR-05 without a cleared record of this type.

dep_keystone_ingress_id.description: Stable identifier for this DEP.KEYSTONE ingress record. Format: DKI-<descriptor>-<seq>.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Must be 1.0.0 for records governed by this schema.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when this ingress record was created.

source_id.description: Source registry ID of the artifact being cleared (e.g., L1-001). Must match an entry in the Training Source Registry.

source_name.description: Human-readable name of the artifact being cleared.

source_type.description: Machine-readable category of the artifact (e.g., logos_owned_doctrine, synthetic_instruction_data).

classification.description: Handling classification for this ingress record.

admissibility_status.description: Current admissibility lifecycle status. Only 'approved' permits training pipeline entry.

admissibility_decision.description: Specific decision made at the DEP.KEYSTONE ingress gate. Only 'accepted_for_clearance' permits pipeline entry.

keystone_evidence_ref.description: Reference (URI, path, or ID) to the DEP.KEYSTONE supply-chain evidence package for this artifact.

keystone_verification_report_ref.description: Reference to the DEP.KEYSTONE verification report that confirmed artifact integrity.

keystone_sbom_ref.description: Reference to the Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) for this artifact. May be a sentinel value for non-software artifacts.

evidence_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the DEP.KEYSTONE evidence package. Must be non-empty for approved records.

artifact_sha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the artifact being cleared. Must be non-empty for approved records.

govsec_layer.description: GovSec V2 layer classification for this ingress record.

reality_formation_input.description: Whether this artifact is a reality-formation input under GovSec V2 / Layer Zero doctrine. Training corpora, fine-tuning corpora, synthetic data, and embeddings must be true.

ingress_actor_id.description: Identifier of the operator or system that submitted this ingress record.

ingress_actor_role.description: Role of the ingress actor (e.g., ingress_reviewer, automated_pipeline, hp_operator).

operator_review_required.description: Whether operator review of this record is required before pipeline use. Must be true for training data.

training_pipeline_allowed.description: Whether the artifact may enter the training pipeline. Must be true for approved records that will be used in TR-04A/TR-03/TR-04B/TR-05.

allowed_next_gates.description: Ordered list of training pipeline gates this cleared artifact may enter. Each entry must be a valid gate name.

notes.description: Free-text governance notes. Should record evidence disposition, conditions of clearance, and any operator remarks.

x-invariants.approved_requires_evidence_hashes: Records with admissibility_status=approved must have non-empty evidence_sha256 and artifact_sha256.
x-invariants.approved_requires_evidence_refs: Records with admissibility_status=approved must have non-empty keystone_evidence_ref and keystone_verification_report_ref.
x-invariants.approved_requires_training_allowed: Records with admissibility_status=approved that enter the pipeline must have training_pipeline_allowed=true.
x-invariants.reality_formation_inputs_must_be_cleared: All training corpora, fine-tuning corpora, synthetic data, embeddings, retrieved documents, and memory layer inputs must have reality_formation_input=true and be cleared through this gate before pipeline entry.
x-invariants.no_duplicate_system: This schema introduces the DEP.KEYSTONE gate where none previously existed. Do not create a parallel system.
